# SkydentalAZ

> Sky Dental is an affordable, dentist-owned dental practice in Phoenix, Arizona offering comprehensive family dentistry, orthodontics, implants, cosmetic services, and emergency care across multiple locations.

Sky Dental operates five locations throughout the Phoenix metropolitan area, led by founder Dr. Scott Connell. The practice specializes in making quality dental care accessible through financing options, insurance acceptance (including AHCCCS and Medicare), and competitive pricing.

## Key Topics

- Dental implants
- Orthodontics and braces
- Cosmetic dentistry
- Emergency dental care
- Teeth whitening
- Family dentistry
- Dental bonding

- All-on-4 solutions
- Financing options

- Affordable dentistry
- Same-day crowns
